# UI: shared RecipeEditor with toolchain checkboxes in Settings → Sandbox ## What to build graph-manager's web UI (React, `apps/graph-manager/src/web`) gets a reusable **`RecipeEditor`** component for the sandbox image recipe, and Settings → Sandbox → Image (`SandboxImage.tsx`) uses it instead of the base, packages and extra-lines fields it has now. The server already speaks the new recipe shape: - **Recipe**: `{ base: string; toolchains: { id, enabled, snippet }[]; extraLines: string }`, where `toolchains` always lists all 7 ids (`python`, `java`, `go`, `rust`, `ruby`, `php`, `cpp`) and the array order is the Dockerfile order. - **`GET /api/settings/sandbox`** answers `{ limits, recipe, defaultRecipe, toolchains: [{ id, name, snippet }], dockerfile, image }`, where `toolchains` holds the names and default snippets. - **`PUT /api/settings/sandbox`** takes `{ recipe }` or `{ recipe: null }` and answers the same view. It answers 400 `{ error }` for an invalid recipe and 409 while a build runs. - **`POST /api/sandbox/dockerfile`** takes `{ recipe }` and answers 200 `{ dockerfile, image, error? }`, where `error` is a validation message such as `toolchains.python: FROM is not allowed; use COPY --from=`. It saves nothing. - **`POST /api/sandbox/rebuild`** answers 202 `{ build }`. - **`GET /api/sandbox/build`** answers a `SandboxBuild` `{ state: "idle" | "queued" | "building" | "ready" | "failed", step?, startedAt?, finishedAt?, error?, log }`. Another slice reuses `RecipeEditor` in the workspace settings drawer, so it must not fetch settings or save anything itself. It takes the recipe and calls `onChange`. It only calls the preview route. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/SandboxImage.tsx`, all 275 lines: the current Image form. It has the load, `putRecipe`, `save`, `reset` and `rebuild` functions, build polling every `BUILD_POLL_MS = 2000`, the `onBuilt` callback, log auto-scroll and the test ids `sandbox-base`, `sandbox-packages`, `sandbox-extra`, `sandbox-dockerfile`, `sandbox-save-recipe`, `sandbox-reset-recipe`, `sandbox-rebuild`, `sandbox-build-state`, `sandbox-build-log`, `sandbox-build-error`, `sandbox-recipe-error` and `sandbox-recipe-load-error`. Keep its structure and the save, reset and rebuild behaviour; replace the three fields with ``. - Lines 27–51 are `BuildBadge`. Add a `queued` state there. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/SandboxCard.tsx`, lines 112–135: where `` sits. No change is expected. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts`, lines 115–139: the `SandboxRecipe`, `SandboxBuild` and `SandboxSettings` types to update. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.css`, lines 42–52: the `.sandbox-recipe*` styles. Add the toolchain row styles here with the same tokens (`var(--space-2)`, `var(--border)`, `var(--radius-md)`, `var(--fg2)`, `var(--font-mono)`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/SandboxCard.test.tsx`, all 156 lines: the test pattern, with a `stub()` fetch mock, `renderCard()` inside `ToastProvider`, `el(testId)`, `fireEvent` and `waitFor`. It uses the old `packages` shape; rewrite it. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/api.ts`: `api(url)` for GET, and `post(url, body, method = "POST")`. ## Patterns to follow **Types** (`types.ts`): ```ts export type ToolchainId = "python" | "java" | "go" | "rust" | "ruby" | "php" | "cpp"; export interface RecipeToolchain { id: ToolchainId; enabled: boolean; snippet: string } export interface SandboxRecipe { base: string; toolchains: RecipeToolchain[]; extraLines: string } export interface ToolchainInfo { id: ToolchainId; name: string; snippet: string } export interface SandboxSettings { limits: SandboxLimits; recipe: SandboxRecipe; defaultRecipe: SandboxRecipe; toolchains: ToolchainInfo[]; dockerfile: string; image: string } export interface DockerfilePreview { dockerfile: string; image: string; error?: string } // SandboxBuild.state gains "queued" ``` **`RecipeEditor` props** (new file `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/RecipeEditor.tsx`): ```ts export const PREVIEW_DEBOUNCE_MS = 300; export function RecipeEditor(props: { recipe: SandboxRecipe; toolchains: ToolchainInfo[]; // names + default snippets, from the settings response onChange: (r: SandboxRecipe) => void; disabled?: boolean; testIdPrefix?: string; // default "recipe"; ids below use it }): JSX.Element ``` **What the editor renders**, with `p` = the test-id prefix: - **Base image**: - A field labelled "Base image", input `${p}-base`, with the classes `input mono`, `autoComplete="off"` and `spellCheck={false}`. - The hint is "A Node image (node 20+, git, glibc). The toolchains are added on top." - **Toolchains**: a list (`
